classification.difficultyReason: Measure several related lengths on one fixed-scale plan, convert to real dimensions and combine the first two for rectangular area; method and requested steps are explicit.

content.prompt: This plan of a tennis court is drawn to a scale of 1 cm to represent 230 cm. By taking measurements with your ruler, answer the questions below.

spec.description: One native editable plan preserves all court lines and three original labels. Its fixed145mm bounding canvas contains the104mm by48mm court,24mm baseline-to-service distances and approximately6.174mm singles alleys. These physical dimensions are required for ruler measurement; do not resize as ordinary illustrative artwork.
spec.mathematics: Scale1cm represents230cm. Original intended approximate keyed dimensions23.92m/11.04m/5.52m/264.08m²/about1.42m follow physical measurement; no numerical dimension is printed as a new given.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the original plan geometry/line labels, with no dimension numbers or computed answers.

children.label: a
children.prompt: What is the approximate length of the court?

answer.worked:
The plan length is approximately $10.4\text{ cm}$. At the given scale,
$$10.4\times230=2392\text{ cm}=23.92\text{ m}.$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: What is the approximate width of the court?

answer.worked:
The plan width is approximately $4.8\text{ cm}$. Hence
$$4.8\times230=1104\text{ cm}=11.04\text{ m}.$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: Find the approximate distance from the base line to the service line on the same side of the net.

answer.worked:
The plan distance is approximately $2.4\text{ cm}$. Hence
$$2.4\times230=552\text{ cm}=5.52\text{ m}.$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: What is the approximate area of the court?

answer.worked:
Use the approximate real length and width from parts a and b:
$$\text{Area}\approx23.92\times11.04=264.0768\text{ m}^2\approx264.08\text{ m}^2.$$

children.label: e
children.prompt: What is the approximate distance between the singles side line and doubles side line on each side of the court?

answer.worked:
The plan gap is about $0.62\text{ cm}$. Using the more precise plan measurement of about $0.617\text{ cm}$,
$$0.617\times230\div100\approx1.42\text{ m}.$$
Small ruler-measurement differences are expected.
